datasets.title: Geodata of Satellite Detected Waters Evolution in Central Bangladesh - Preliminary Report
datasets.description: Preliminary Satellite Detected Waters Evolution in Central Bangladesh Report (28 July 2016). [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-satellite-detected-waters-evolution-in-central-bangladesh-prelimin-july-29-2016]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts compared multi-temporal satellite imagery acquired on 25 July 2016 to detect changes in water extent and map flood inundation areas in Central Bangladesh. Water bodies were delineated through visual interpretation and automated change detection, with results delivered as vector polygons with area measurements in hectares and square meters.

sources.name: United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite imagery analysis and water extent mapping derived from multi-temporal satellite image comparison to detect flood inundation areas during the July 2016 Bangladesh flooding event.
